accesskeys.note: Best practice, not a WCAG requirement.
accesskeys.help: accesskey attribute value should be unique

area-alt.note: Image-map area without a name: the link has no name a screen reader can read.
area-alt.help: Active <area> elements must have alternative text

aria-allowed-attr.note: Unsupported ARIA attribute: real impact depends on what assistive technology does with it.
aria-allowed-attr.help: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes

aria-allowed-role.note: Role not allowed on the element: barrier only when semantics or operation are lost.
aria-allowed-role.help: ARIA role should be appropriate for the element

aria-braille-equivalent.note: Braille label without a spoken equivalent: needs a check of the real name.
aria-braille-equivalent.help: aria-braille attributes must have a non-braille equivalent

aria-command-name.note: Control with a command role and no name: people cannot tell what it does.
aria-command-name.help: ARIA commands must have an accessible name

aria-conditional-attr.note: Attribute only valid in some contexts: impact depends on the widget.
aria-conditional-attr.help: ARIA attributes must be used as specified for the element's role

aria-deprecated-role.note: Deprecated role: support varies; barrier must be shown.
aria-deprecated-role.help: Deprecated ARIA roles must not be used

aria-dialog-name.note: Dialog without a name: best practice in axe; review whether context makes purpose clear.
aria-dialog-name.help: ARIA dialog and alertdialog nodes should have an accessible name

aria-hidden-body.note: The whole page is hidden from assistive technology.
aria-hidden-body.help: aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body
aria-hidden-body.trustWithoutAct: aria-hidden on <body> hides the whole page from assistive technology; no exception applies.

aria-hidden-focus.note: Keyboard reaches something screen readers are told to ignore.
aria-hidden-focus.help: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements

aria-input-field-name.note: Input with an ARIA role and no name.
aria-input-field-name.help: ARIA input fields must have an accessible name

aria-meter-name.help: ARIA meter nodes must have an accessible name
aria-meter-name.trustWithoutAct: A meter with no accessible name at all; nothing to judge beyond the missing name.

aria-progressbar-name.help: ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name
aria-progressbar-name.trustWithoutAct: A progress bar with no accessible name at all; nothing to judge beyond the missing name.

aria-prohibited-attr.note: Prohibited attribute: often harmless; review the real name and role.
aria-prohibited-attr.help: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes

aria-required-attr.note: Widget role missing a state it needs (e.g. checked), so its value cannot be read.
aria-required-attr.help: Required ARIA attributes must be provided

aria-required-children.note: Composite widget missing required children: confirm the loss of structure.
aria-required-children.help: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children

aria-required-parent.note: Item outside its required container: confirm the loss of structure.
aria-required-parent.help: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents

aria-roledescription.note: Role description on an unsuitable element.
aria-roledescription.help: aria-roledescription must be on elements with a semantic role

aria-roles.note: Invalid role value: the element has no usable role for assistive technology.
aria-roles.help: ARIA roles used must conform to valid values

aria-tab-name.note: Tab with no name: screen reader users cannot tell the tabs apart.
aria-tab-name.help: ARIA tab nodes must have an accessible name
aria-tab-name.trustWithoutAct: A tab with no accessible name at all; nothing to judge beyond the missing name.

aria-toggle-field-name.help: ARIA toggle fields must have an accessible name

aria-tooltip-name.help: ARIA tooltip nodes must have an accessible name
aria-tooltip-name.trustWithoutAct: A tooltip with no accessible name at all; nothing to judge beyond the missing name.

aria-treeitem-name.note: Tree item name is a best practice in axe.
aria-treeitem-name.help: ARIA treeitem nodes should have an accessible name

aria-valid-attr.note: Misspelled or invented ARIA attribute: the intended state or name is lost.
aria-valid-attr.help: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names

aria-valid-attr-value.note: Invalid ARIA value: the stated relationship or state is lost.
aria-valid-attr-value.help: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values

audio-caption.note: Audio needs a transcript; whether one exists nearby needs a person.
audio-caption.help: <audio> elements must have a captions track

autocomplete-valid.note: Invalid autocomplete token: browsers cannot fill the field for the person.
autocomplete-valid.help: autocomplete attribute must be used correctly

avoid-inline-spacing.note: Inline !important spacing blocks people who override text spacing.
avoid-inline-spacing.help: Inline text spacing must be adjustable with custom stylesheets

blink.note: Blinking content that cannot be stopped.
blink.help: <blink> elements are deprecated and must not be used
blink.reviewReason: Browsers no longer render <blink>; whether anything moves, and for how long, needs a look.

button-name.note: Button with no name: screen readers announce only "button".

bypass.note: No way to skip repeated blocks found; confirm that no other bypass mechanism exists (disputed: skip link is one way).
bypass.help: Page must have means to bypass repeated blocks

color-contrast.note: Measured text contrast below the threshold.
color-contrast.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

color-contrast-enhanced.note: Measured text contrast below the AAA threshold.
color-contrast-enhanced.help: Elements must meet enhanced color contrast ratio thresholds

css-orientation-lock.note: CSS locks the page to one orientation.
css-orientation-lock.help: CSS Media queries must not lock display orientation

definition-list.note: Malformed definition list: confirm a real loss of structure.
definition-list.help: <dl> elements must only directly contain properly-ordered <dt> and <dd> groups, <script>, <template> or <div> elements

dlitem.note: Definition item outside a list: confirm a real loss of structure.
dlitem.help: <dt> and <dd> elements must be contained by a <dl>

document-title.note: Page has no title, so tabs and history are unnamed.
document-title.help: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation

duplicate-id.note: Duplicate ids: 4.1.1 is obsolete in WCAG 2.2; only a lost relationship matters.
duplicate-id.help: id attribute value must be unique

duplicate-id-active.note: Duplicate ids on focusable elements: investigate relationships, not a failure by itself.
duplicate-id-active.help: IDs of active elements must be unique

duplicate-id-aria.note: Duplicate id used by a label or description: the wrong text may be read.
duplicate-id-aria.help: IDs used in ARIA and labels must be unique

empty-heading.note: Empty heading: confirm it is announced and misleads.

empty-table-header.help: Table header text should not be empty

focus-order-semantics.note: Focusable element without an interactive role.
focus-order-semantics.help: Elements in the focus order should have an appropriate role

form-field-multiple-labels.note: Several labels on one field: some screen readers read only one.
form-field-multiple-labels.help: Form field must not have multiple label elements

frame-focusable-content.note: Frame with focusable content removed from keyboard order.
frame-focusable-content.help: Frames with focusable content must not have tabindex=-1

frame-tested.help: Frames should be tested with axe-core

frame-title.note: Frame with no name: screen reader users cannot tell what it contains.
frame-title.help: Frames must have an accessible name

frame-title-unique.help: Frames must have a unique title attribute

heading-order.note: Skipped heading level: disputed advice, never a failure by itself.
heading-order.help: Heading levels should only increase by one

hidden-content.help: Hidden content on the page should be analyzed

html-has-lang.note: Page language not set: screen readers may read it with the wrong pronunciation.
html-has-lang.help: <html> element must have a lang attribute

html-lang-valid.note: Page language code is not valid.
html-lang-valid.help: <html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute

html-xml-lang-mismatch.help: HTML elements with lang and xml:lang must have the same base language
html-xml-lang-mismatch.reviewReason: Its ACT rule (5b7ae0) is deprecated; browsers use lang, so whether the mismatch changes how the page is read needs a look.

identical-links-same-purpose.note: Same name, different target: a best practice (2.4.9 AAA).
identical-links-same-purpose.help: Links with the same name must have a similar purpose

image-alt.note: Image without a text alternative (blocker when it is the only content of a link or button).

image-redundant-alt.note: Alt text repeats nearby text: noise, not a failure.
image-redundant-alt.help: Alternative text of images should not be repeated as text

input-button-name.help: Input buttons must have discernible text

input-image-alt.note: Image button with no text alternative: its action cannot be named.
input-image-alt.help: Image buttons must have alternative text

label.note: Form field with no label that software can read.

label-content-name-mismatch.note: Visible label not in the name: voice control users may not be able to say it; confirm.
label-content-name-mismatch.help: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name

label-title-only.note: Field named only by a title attribute.
label-title-only.help: Form elements should have a visible label

landmark-banner-is-top-level.help: Banner landmark should not be contained in another landmark

landmark-complementary-is-top-level.help: Aside should not be contained in another landmark

landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level.help: Contentinfo landmark should not be contained in another landmark

landmark-main-is-top-level.help: Main landmark should not be contained in another landmark

landmark-no-duplicate-banner.help: Document should not have more than one banner landmark

landmark-no-duplicate-contentinfo.help: Document should not have more than one contentinfo landmark

landmark-no-duplicate-main.help: Document should not have more than one main landmark

landmark-one-main.note: Missing main landmark: disputed advice, not a failure by itself.
landmark-one-main.help: Document should have one main landmark

landmark-unique.help: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination

link-in-text-block.note: Links in text told apart from surrounding text by colour only.
link-in-text-block.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
link-in-text-block.reviewReason: Other cues than colour (weight, icon, position) and the focus/hover cue need a look; the skill measures link contrast itself.

link-name.note: Link with no name: screen readers announce only "link" or the address.

list.note: Malformed list: confirm a real loss of structure.
list.help: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements

listitem.note: List item outside a list: confirm a real loss of structure.
listitem.help: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>

marquee.note: Scrolling marquee text that cannot be stopped.
marquee.help: <marquee> elements are deprecated and must not be used
marquee.reviewReason: 2.2.2 allows motion that stops within 5 seconds or has a pause control; that needs a look.

meta-refresh.note: Page refreshes or redirects on a timer the person cannot control.
meta-refresh.help: Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used

meta-refresh-no-exceptions.note: Timed refresh or redirect (AAA, no exceptions).
meta-refresh-no-exceptions.help: Delayed refresh must not be used

meta-viewport.note: Zoom disabled on mobile, so people cannot enlarge the page.
meta-viewport.help: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled

meta-viewport-large.help: Users should be able to zoom and scale the text up to 500%

nested-interactive.note: Control inside another control: screen readers may not announce or reach the inner one.
nested-interactive.help: Interactive controls must not be nested

no-autoplay-audio.note: Audio plays automatically; whether it lasts over 3 seconds without a stop control needs confirming.
no-autoplay-audio.help: <video> or <audio> elements must not play automatically

object-alt.note: Embedded object with no text alternative.

p-as-heading.note: Bold paragraph styled like a heading: confirm the structure loss before reporting.
p-as-heading.help:
Styled

elements must not be used as headings

page-has-heading-one.note: No h1: disputed advice, not a failure by itself.
page-has-heading-one.help: Page should contain a level-one heading

presentation-role-conflict.note: Element marked decorative is still exposed: confirm the effect.
presentation-role-conflict.help: Elements marked as presentational should be consistently ignored

region.help: All page content should be contained by landmarks

role-img-alt.note: Graphic with role img and no name.
role-img-alt.help: [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements must have alternative text

scope-attr-valid.help: scope attribute should be used correctly

scrollable-region-focusable.note: Scrolling area that keyboard users cannot reach or scroll.
scrollable-region-focusable.help: Scrollable region must have keyboard access

select-name.help: Select element must have an accessible name

server-side-image-map.note: Server-side image map cannot be used with a keyboard.
server-side-image-map.help: Server-side image maps must not be used
server-side-image-map.trustWithoutAct: A server-side image map only works with pointer coordinates; there is no keyboard path.

skip-link.note: Skip link target missing: confirm the link is the only bypass mechanism.
skip-link.help: The skip-link target should exist and be focusable

summary-name.help: Summary elements must have discernible text
summary-name.trustWithoutAct: A <summary> control with no accessible name at all; nothing to judge beyond the missing name.

svg-img-alt.note: SVG graphic with role img and no name.
svg-img-alt.help: <svg> elements with an img or image role must have alternative text

tabindex.note: Positive tabindex: disputed advice; only a broken focus order (2.4.3) is a failure.
tabindex.help: Elements should not have tabindex greater than zero

table-duplicate-name.help: Tables should not have the same summary and caption

table-fake-caption.note: Fake caption cell: confirm the structure loss.
table-fake-caption.help: Data or header cells must not be used to give caption to a data table.

target-size.note: Clickable area below 24 by 24 pixels without enough spacing.
target-size.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
target-size.reviewReason: The spacing, equivalent-control, inline and essential exceptions of 2.5.8 need a look; the skill measures target size itself.

td-has-header.note: Large table cell without headers: confirm the relationship is lost.
td-has-header.help: Non-empty <td> elements in larger <table> must have an associated table header

td-headers-attr.note: Table cell points at headers that do not exist in the table.
td-headers-attr.help: Table cell headers attributes must refer to other <th> elements in the same table

th-has-data-cells.note: Header cell with no data cells: confirm the structure loss.
th-has-data-cells.help: Table headers in a data table must refer to data cells

valid-lang.note: Language of a part of the page set with an invalid code.
valid-lang.help: lang attribute must have a valid value

video-caption.note: Video without a captions track; whether captions exist another way needs confirming.

trustRule: A rule produces a fail on its own only when trust is "confirmed" AND a current W3C ACT rule in kb/data/act-rules.json tests one of its criteria, or trustWithoutAct says why none is needed. Everything else goes to a judge.
